pr_title: Enable RISC-V PMP & userspace support on RV64 QEMU
pr_body:
This PR enables RISC-V PMP on `qemu_riscv64` to improve CI testing of RISC-V userspace.
It fixes 64-bit compatible bugs of RISC-V PMP & userspace in riscv64.

We finally have QEMU support of RISC-V userspace in both RV32 & RV64 after this PR.
Thanks for everyone reviewing my PRs.

Fix #31811
pr_comments:
@katsuster @henrikbrixandersen 
Could you please help to review this PR? It is primarily a 64-bit compatible bugfix for RV64.

issue_context.title: Enable RISC-V memory protection on QEMU virt board
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
Current RISC-V platforms [1] doesn't have enough RAM to run some memory protection tests. (#30066)

**Describe the solution you'd like**
QEMU virt board supports RISC-V PMP and has the configurable RAM size, it doesn't encounter RAM overflow problem.
Also, we can test RV64 support by virt board.

Because virt board is non-XIP platform, it needs some fixes to support PMP.

Planning:
1. Passing `samples/userspace/` and `tests/kernel/mem_protect/` on RV32 QEMU virt board (`qemu_riscv32` board)
2. Passing them on RV64 QEMU virt board (`qemu_riscv64` board)

This issue is for tracking progress and related issues.

**Additional context**
[1] In #30066, `hifive_revb` doesn't have enough RAM for mem_protect test. ~~and QEMU sifive_e machine has same RAM size. (it's qemu_riscv32 before #31166)~~
comments:
RV32 QEMU virt board status:

Current branch: [qemu_virt_pmp_v4](https://github.com/cwshu/zephyr/commits/qemu_virt_pmp_v4)

Failed cases in `samples/userspace/` and `tests/kernel/mem_protect/`:
- [x]  `syscalls` is only failed on accessing FAULTY_ADDRESS.
- [x]  `protection` doesn't work on RISC-V non-XIP system currently because ROM isn't protected by PMP.
ROM protection relies on flash to be non-writable in real HW. (see CONFIG_RISCV_PMP help)

Failed cases in `userspace` tag:
- [x] `tests/crypto/mbedtls/crypto.mbedtls`: related to .sdata section in mbedtls: `mbedtls_calloc_func` symbol
- [x] `ztest/error_hook`: failed in divided by zero
- [x] `tests/lib/mem_alloc`: related to .sdata section in libc: `_impure_ptr` symbol 

----

- ROM protection of PMP requires QEMU 6.0.0. 
(p.s. It also hit QEMU RISC-V bug, see 3F for detail.)

**Update**: QEMU virt board updates to `qemu_riscv32` platform
**Update (07/17)**: [PATCH v2] Rebase to Zephyr v2.6 and fix new bugs
**Update (09/01)**: [PATCH v3] Fix `syscalls` & `ztest/error_hook`. Fix #36829 for newest Zephyr
**Update (10/09)**: [PATCH v4] Finish ROM protection of PMP to support `protection`.  Fix `crypto.mbedtls` & `mem_alloc`.

**Update**: QEMU bugfix has been finished and sent to [mailing list](https://lists.nongnu.org/archive/html/qemu-riscv/2021-02/msg00142.html).
I will go back to work on Zephyr to support remaining 2 testcases.

**Update**: QEMU bugfix has been [merged](https://lists.nongnu.org/archive/html/qemu-riscv/2021-03/msg00162.html) in QEMU 6.0.0
